subject: Post-call: QuantifyApp technical discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Carter <jamie@quantifyapp.com>, Anita Bose <anita.b@quantifyapp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: QuantifyApp technical discovery & next steps

Hi Jamie / Anita —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Below is a concise recap of what we heard on the call, the immediate technical questions we need to answer, and proposed next steps so we can scope a benchmark and deployment plan.

Key pain points you described:
- User-facing generation latency is impacting real-time chat flows (noticeable delays at peak).
- Costs are spiking during business hours due to inefficient batching and a mix of embedding + generation workloads.
- Compliance: need private networking (VPC peering) and SOC 2 controls for PII in prompts.

Goals (what success looks like):
1) P95 token latency <= 250ms for standard prompts in the chat assistant at projected steady-state load.
2) Support initial traffic of ~150 RPS for generation (bursty to 400 RPS) and up to 2,000 QPS for embedding requests once index refreshes start.
3) Stay within forecasted monthly inference budget; aim for 35–45% unit-cost reduction vs current baseline within 3 months via batching, caching, and quantization.

Technical summary / model preferences:
- Primary model family: open LLMs (Quantize-friendly; likely 13B/30B variants).
- Embeddings: low-latency small models (quantized), separate endpoint to isolate throughput.
- KV cache requirements: long-lived session contexts (up to ~4096 tokens typical; occasional 16k).

Initial topology options discussed:
- Private Dedicated (preferred): Redwood Dedicated pool in us-west with VPC peering to QuantifyApp infra for compliance and predictable throughput.
- Hosted fallback: Redwood-hosted API for burst overflow and canary testing.

Immediate questions / data needed from your side to size benchmarks:
1) Representative sample payloads (3–5 typical generation prompts + embedding sample set).
2) Expected concurrency (typical and peak) per endpoint (chat vs embeddings).
3) Any latency SLOs for cold-starts / first token versus steady-state?
4) Network egress constraints and preferred VPC CIDR ranges for peering.

Proposed next steps:
- You: Share sample payloads and the completed security questionnaire (attached).
- Us: Prepare a 2-day benchmark plan (CPU/GPU profiles, quantization options) and send a short runbook.
- Schedule a focused technical deep-dive (model sizing + SLO verification) — suggested window: Thu 08/27 10:00–11:30 PT.

Attachments: quantifyapp-mutual-action-plan.xlsx, network-topology-screenshot.png

If this aligns, I'll confirm the deep-dive and circulate the benchmark plan.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Jamie Carter <jamie@quantifyapp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anita Bose <anita.b@quantifyapp.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuantifyApp technical discovery & next steps

Karthik —

This summary is great, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:
- The P95 latency target can be relaxed to 250ms if that materially reduces cost; 200ms would be ideal but may not be realistic on day one.
- Generation profile: steady-state ~120–180 RPS with spikes to 450 RPS during end-of-day batch jobs.
- Embeddings: roughly 1.5–2k QPS during index rebuilds (those are short windows, 10–30 minutes).
- Context windows: 4k for most sessions; we do have intermittent 16k long-form sessions (less than 5% of traffic).
- Compliance: SOC 2 + VPC peering required. We will share the signed security questionnaire by EOD.

We are targeting an internal pilot by late Oct (aiming to go live for a handful of customers then), with broader rollout in Q1 2027.

Attaching the security questionnaire (the PDF is a filled copy). Thanks for proposing the benchmark runbook — please include quantized model options (8-bit / 4-bit) and a cost-per-token forecast for each option.

Cheers,
Jamie
Head of Platform
QuantifyApp
jamie@quantifyapp.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call: QuantifyApp technical discovery & next steps (internal)

Karthik / Aditya —

Internal checklist I suggest we use to accelerate the benchmark and sizing work:
1) Benchmarks: two phases — phase A (latency-focused): 13B quantized (8-bit/4-bit) + embedding small model; phase B (throughput/cost): 30B quantized batch runs and dedicated pooling tests.
2) Test harness: simulate 3 traffic profiles — steady chat RPS 150, burst chat up to 450, embedding rebuild windows up to 2000 QPS for 20m.
3) Required from customer: sample payloads, VPC CIDR, expected DB/location for index storage, and sample token lengths distribution.
4) Deliverables: bench report (latency / p50/p95/p99), cost table (per 1M tokens), recommended topology (Dedicated pool + hosted overflow).

I'll draft the bench-plan doc and the Runbook template. If Aditya can scope required GPU-hours, we can include estimated cost and timeline in the first pass.

-L

Lauren Bishop
Principal Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: QuantifyApp technical discovery & next steps

Jamie / Anita —

Appreciate the quick clarifications and the completed security questionnaire — got it. TL;DR of what we'll do next and confirmed times: 

Confirmed:
- Deep-dive: Thu 27 Aug 2026, 10:00–11:30 PT — calendar invite will follow.
- Bench plan: we will run Phase A within 72 hours of receiving sample payloads; Phase B sizing will follow based on Phase A outcomes.
- Deliverables: bench report (latency p50/p95/p99), cost-per-token scenarios (unquantized / 8-bit / 4-bit), and a recommended deployment topology (Dedicated pool in us-west + hosted overflow).

Action items (owner / due):
- QuantifyApp: share sample payloads + VPC CIDR by EOD Wed 08/26 (Jamie).
- Redwood (Aditya): produce preliminary GPU-hours estimate and bench-plan doc (redwood-bench-plan.md) by Wed 08/26 COB.
- Redwood (Lauren): Ops runbook & rollback plan for canary (Wed 08/26).

Attachments: redwood-bench-plan.md (draft) — this contains the test scenarios, metrics to collect, and data formatting guidelines.

If anything needs adjusting before the deep-dive, flag here and we'll update. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
